# Issues

<!-- auto-generated by cmd/docgen — do not edit -->

Issues are the core entity in Jira. Each issue belongs to a project, has a type
(bug, story, task, epic, …), a status, and optional fields like assignee,
priority, labels, components, and linked issues.

An issue key has the form `PROJECT-NUMBER` (e.g. `MYPROJ-42`). Always use the
full key when referring to a specific issue.

## jira issue list

List issues in a project, optionally filtered by JQL or individual flags.

**Aliases:** `ls`, `search`

### Usage

```
jira issue list [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `-p` | Project key (defaults to context project) |
| `--jql` | `-q` | JQL filter expression |
| `--status` | `-s` | Filter by status (e.g. "In Progress", "Done") |
| `--type` | `-T` | Filter by issue type (bug, story, task, epic, …) |
| `--assignee` | `-a` | Filter by assignee (account ID or `me`) |
| `--reporter` | | Filter by reporter (account ID or `me`) |
| `--priority` | | Filter by priority (Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest) |
| `--label` | | Filter by label (repeatable) |
| `--component` | | Filter by component name |
| `--sprint` | | Filter by sprint name or ID |
| `--epic` | | Filter by epic key |
| `--created` | | Created date filter (e.g. `-7d`, `2024-01-01`) |
| `--updated` | | Updated date filter |
| `--limit` | `-L` | Maximum issues to display (default 50) |
| `--mine` | | Shorthand for `--assignee me` |
| `--no-headers` | | Suppress column headers |

### Inherited Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--context` | `-c` | Active Jira context name |
| `--format` | | Output format: json or yaml |
| `--jq` | | Apply a jq expression to JSON output |
| `--json` | | Output in JSON format |
| `--yaml` | | Output in YAML format |
| `--template` | | Render output using Go templates |

### Examples

```bash
# List open issues in the active project
jira issue list

# List all bugs with high priority
jira issue list --type bug --priority High

# JQL search — in-progress issues assigned to me
jira issue list --jql "assignee = currentUser() AND status = 'In Progress'"

# Issues in the current sprint
jira issue list --jql "sprint in openSprints()" --json

# Recent bugs (last 7 days)
jira issue list --type bug --created -7d --limit 20

# All issues assigned to me
jira issue list --mine

# Issues with a specific label
jira issue list --label backend --label api
```

## jira issue view

Display detailed information about a Jira issue.

Shows summary, status, type, priority, assignee, reporter, description,
and optionally comments and worklogs.

### Usage

```
jira issue view <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--comments` | | Show comments |
| `--worklogs` | | Show worklogs |
| `--web` | `-w` | Open in browser |

### Examples

```bash
jira issue view MYPROJ-42
jira issue view MYPROJ-42 --comments
jira issue view MYPROJ-42 --comments --worklogs
jira issue view MYPROJ-42 --json
jira issue view MYPROJ-42 --web
```

---

## jira issue create

Create a new issue in a Jira project.

### Usage

```
jira issue create [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `-p` | Project key (defaults to context project) |
| `--title` | `-t` | Issue summary/title |
| `--body` | `-b` | Issue description (plain text or ADF JSON) |
| `--type` | `-T` | Issue type (bug, story, task, epic, subtask, …) |
| `--priority` | | Priority (Highest, High, Medium, Low, Lowest) |
| `--assignee` | `-a` | Assignee account ID or `me` |
| `--reporter` | | Reporter account ID |
| `--label` | | Label to add (repeatable) |
| `--component` | | Component name (repeatable) |
| `--epic` | `-e` | Parent epic key |
| `--sprint` | | Sprint name or ID to add issue to |
| `--parent` | | Parent issue key (for subtasks) |
| `--custom` | | Set a custom field: `--custom fieldId=value` (repeatable) |
| `--no-input` | | Skip interactive prompts; fail if required fields missing |
| `--web` | `-w` | Open the created issue in browser |

### Examples

```bash
# Create a bug interactively
jira issue create

# Create a bug with all flags
jira issue create \
  --project MYPROJ \
  --title "Login button broken" \
  --body "The login button does not respond on Safari" \
  --type bug \
  --priority High \
  --assignee me \
  --label frontend

# Create a story in an epic
jira issue create -p MYPROJ -t "Add dark mode" -T story -e MYPROJ-10

# Create a subtask
jira issue create -p MYPROJ -t "Write unit tests" -T subtask --parent MYPROJ-42

# Create and open in browser
jira issue create -p MYPROJ -t "Deploy to staging" -T task --web
```

## jira issue edit

Edit an existing issue. Only the fields you specify are updated.

### Usage

```
jira issue edit <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--title` | `-t` | Update summary |
| `--body` | `-b` | Update description |
| `--type` | `-T` | Update issue type |
| `--priority` | | Update priority |
| `--assignee` | `-a` | Update assignee (account ID, `me`, or empty string to unassign) |
| `--label` | | Add a label (repeatable) |
| `--remove-label` | | Remove a label (repeatable) |
| `--component` | | Add a component (repeatable) |
| `--remove-component` | | Remove a component (repeatable) |
| `--custom` | | Set a custom field: `--custom fieldId=value` (repeatable) |

### Examples

```bash
# Update the summary
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --title "Corrected title"

# Change assignee to yourself
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --assignee me

# Unassign
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --assignee ""

# Change priority and add a label
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --priority Critical --label urgent

# Set a custom field
jira issue edit MYPROJ-42 --custom story_points=5
```

## jira issue transition

Transition an issue to a new status.

### Usage

```
jira issue transition <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` | | Target status name or transition name |
| `--comment` | | Add a comment during transition |
| `--resolution` | | Set resolution (Done, Won't Fix, Duplicate, …) |

### Examples

```bash
# Interactive picker
jira issue transition MYPROJ-42

# Direct transition by name
jira issue transition MYPROJ-42 --to "In Progress"
jira issue transition MYPROJ-42 --to "Done" --resolution "Fixed"

# Transition with a comment
jira issue transition MYPROJ-42 --to "Closed" --comment "Deployed to production"
```

---

## jira issue assign

Assign (or unassign) an issue.

### Usage

```
jira issue assign <issue-key> [assignee] [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--assignee` | `-a` | Account ID or `me` (use empty string to unassign) |

### Examples

```bash
jira issue assign MYPROJ-42 me
jira issue assign MYPROJ-42 --assignee "5f86...abc"
jira issue assign MYPROJ-42 --assignee ""   # unassign
```

## jira issue comment

Manage comments on an issue. Subcommands: `add`, `list`, `edit`, `delete`.

See [comment](comment.md) for the full reference.

### Quick examples

```bash
jira issue comment add MYPROJ-42 -b "Fixed in v1.2.0"
jira issue comment list MYPROJ-42
```

---

## jira issue worklog

Manage worklogs on an issue. Subcommands: `add`, `list`, `delete`.

See [worklog](worklog.md) for the full reference.

### Quick examples

```bash
jira issue worklog add MYPROJ-42 --time 2h --comment "Implemented the feature"
jira issue worklog list MYPROJ-42
```

---

## jira issue link

Link two issues together.

### Usage

```
jira issue link <issue-key> <link-type> <target-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--type` | | Link type (blocks, clones, duplicates, relates to, …) |

### Examples

```bash
jira issue link MYPROJ-42 blocks MYPROJ-43
jira issue link MYPROJ-42 "relates to" MYPROJ-99
jira issue link MYPROJ-42 duplicates MYPROJ-10
```

---

## jira issue clone

Clone an issue (duplicate with the same fields).

### Usage

```
jira issue clone <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--title` | `-t` | Override the summary for the clone |
| `--assignee` | `-a` | Assign the clone to a different user |

### Examples

```bash
jira issue clone MYPROJ-42
jira issue clone MYPROJ-42 --title "Copy: Login button broken" --assignee me
```

---

## jira issue delete

Permanently delete an issue.

> **Warning**: This action cannot be undone.

### Usage

```
jira issue delete <issue-key> [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | | Skip confirmation prompt |
| `--delete-subtasks` | | Also delete all subtasks |

### Examples

```bash
jira issue delete MYPROJ-42
jira issue delete MYPROJ-42 --confirm
jira issue delete MYPROJ-42 --confirm --delete-subtasks
```

---

## jira issue status

Show a dashboard of issues relevant to you: assigned, reported, recently updated.

### Usage

```
jira issue status [flags]
```

### Flags

| Flag | Short | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | `-p` | Limit to a specific project |
| `--limit` | `-L` | Max issues per category (default 10) |

### Examples

```bash
jira issue status
jira issue status --project MYPROJ
jira issue status --json
```
